verdict.rationale: Factory documents mentioning `@Factory` in Linear and Jira issue comments to have Droid investigate, implement, and test work. That is direct tag-to-delegate support, but in issue-comment threads rather than a chat thread. Slack is listed only as a synchronization integration, with no documented @-mention delegation. Missing for 10: documented tagging of the agent in a chat app thread (e.g. Slack), evidence of conversational back-and-forth discussion with the agent in the thread, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can tag an agent in a chat thread to discuss and delegate a bug or task

citations.quote: Assign a Linear issue to Factory or mention `@Factory` in an issue comment to have Droid investigate, implement, and test the work.
Assign a Jira issue to Factory or mention `@Factory` in an issue comment to have Droid investigate, implement, and test the work.
